text.en: Eight artists working with duration, stoppage and the maintenance of a state. The exhibition took its title from the Danish for a machine held at rest under power — not switched off, but prevented from moving.
text.da: Otte kunstnere der arbejder med varighed, standsning og vedligeholdelsen af en tilstand. Udstillingen har titel efter en maskine, der holdes i ro under spænding — ikke slukket, men forhindret i at bevæge sig.
